specs.title: Admin backoffice
specs.why: Operators need a supported way to investigate and reconcile without direct database access.
specs.scope: Internal-only `/admin` for operators: tenant search, audited impersonation, payout reconciliation and abuse reports. Role-gated, with every action audit-logged.
tasks: Impersonation with a banner and audit log
acceptance: Every admin action produces an audit log entry
Impersonation shows a banner in the target tenant session

specs.title: Ghana rollout (Flutterwave default, GHS)
specs.why: A second country validates that country-specific defaults are configuration rather than hard-coded assumptions.
specs.scope: Country support for Ghana behind a feature flag: GHS currency, +233 phone normalization, Flutterwave as default provider, Accra timezone default.
tasks: Currency, phone and timezone defaults per country
E2E booking and payment in GHS
acceptance: Signing up as a Ghana tenant yields the correct defaults
A full booking and payment E2E passes in GHS
No regressions in the Nigeria E2E suite
